findings.explanation: The SPL has no stats, entity or count; it lists individual granted events.
findings.quote: grouped by `entity`. Outputs `count` each `the scheduled window`
findings.suggested_fix: Describe it as one row per after-hours grant.

findings.explanation: The SPL excludes by regex match on the badge_holder name field, not on roles or cost centers, and contains no ticket or CSV join; the unanchored match would also exclude any holder whose name contains those words.
findings.quote: maintain an allowlist of roles or cost centers permitted overnight (`NOC`, `Security`, `Facilities`), require after-hours access requests to write a correlating ticket or CSV flag the search can join
findings.suggested_fix: Either add the role/cost-center lookup and the ticket join to the SPL or describe the regex allowlist honestly.

findings.explanation: The SPL tests hour < 6 OR hour > 22, which leaves out 22:00-22:59, so the stated window and the search disagree.
findings.suggested_fix: Align the prose and the SPL on the same boundary.

findings.explanation: The suggested enrichment looks the file up by `door`, but door is not a column, so the lookup cannot work without a door-to-site mapping.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a door-to-site lookup or key the file on door.

findings.explanation: Mapping physical badge grants to the CIM Authentication model, and the summary-style cimSpl on user/action/src, does not reproduce the after-hours logic and needs confirmation.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the CIM mapping or remove it for physical-only feeds.

findings.explanation: Guide index is physical_security and sourcetypes are vendor-specific; index=physical and access_control are not in the guide.
findings.suggested_fix: Align or mark as a custom normalised feed.

findings.explanation: No real cause (contractors on approved night work, shift changes at the boundary, daylight-saving shifts, controller replay) is named and the fields are not in the SPL.
findings.suggested_fix: List those causes and suppress by door and badge_holder.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Performance does not describe after-hours access detection; Security (or Compliance) fits.
Observability is inconsistent with the Security pillar used by sibling access-control UCs.
hour > 22 excludes 22:00-22:59, contradicting a 22:00 start of quiet hours.
strftime returns a string, so hour < 6 and hour > 22 compare against numbers; verify the comparison semantics and wrap in tonumber() to avoid daytime hours such as 07-15 matching.
SWIFT CSP 6.4 and TSA SD mappings are marked detects-violation-of yet auto-drafted pending SME review, and SWIFT CSP / swift-csp are listed twice.

summary: The implementation guidance is concrete, but the quiet-hours definition, allowlist and ticket join described in prose are not what the SPL does, and the classification (Performance, Observability) does not fit an after-hours badge detection.
